description:
Manage the full lifecycle of a kind='agent' embed (the atomic-slice single-tool surface — discovery, hire, AND authoring). Pick an `op`:
  • list_roster       — MY OPVS-hired roster (Feed A, read-only). Agents this tenant ALREADY hired; each carries `catalog_profile_id` (the FREE-reuse hire key). "I already hired them, let me embed one."
  • list_catalog      — the GLOBAL OPVS storefront to BUY a new agent (Feed B, read-only). Each tile carries `id` (the hire key) + `agent_meta.opvs_catalog.profile_id`.
  • hire              — mint the flow. Pass `catalog_profile_id` (Feed A, free reuse) OR `component_id` (Feed B, OPVS-billed). Returns a `status`: payment_required | provisioning | active. On "active", `flow_id` is what you embed.
  • list_hired        — MY LOCAL kind=agent flows already embedded + each `agent_flow_id` UUID to mount (read-only).
  • create            — new agent embed from an OPVS `agent` binding (needs name + agent). dry_run is OPT-IN.
  • update            — replace the `agent` binding and/or `name` on an existing flow (needs flow_id). dry_run is OPT-IN.
  • publish           — draft→active (needs flow_id). DESTRUCTIVE → SAFE-DEFAULT dry_run: the first call returns a confirm_token; call again with it to publish.
  • preview_url       — canonical /f/{flow_id} URL (needs flow_id; read-only, no API call).
  • get_embed_snippet — copy-paste in-page embed markup (needs flow_id; `mode`: inline | concierge).
Discover→hire→embed: op=list_catalog → op=hire <component_id> → op=list_hired → copy flow_id → op=get_embed_snippet. The `agent` binding is flow.agent — OPVS URLs + ids ONLY, never a secret (credential-shaped keys → 422); it is produced by OPVS provisioning. NEVER hand-compose /f/{id} or the embed markup — get them from op=preview_url / op=get_embed_snippet (the W13 "8 broken iframes" incident). The /f/{id} surface 404s until op=publish flips status to 'active' AND the site is deployed (content_deploy_site). In the kitchen-sink @spideriq/mcp these are separate list_agent_catalog / hire_agent / list_hired_agents / agent_flow_* tools; this is the consolidated mcp-publish equivalent.

agent.description: The flow.agent binding (SHARED CONTRACT §6.1). URLs + ids ONLY — never a secret (credential-shaped keys are rejected with a 422). Produced by OPVS provisioning.

grounding.description: { knowledge_base_id?: string, mode: "page" | "site" | "docs" } — optional; defaults to mode="page".

ui.description: { surface: "flow"|"inline"|"concierge", widgets: string[], theme_inherit: boolean } — optional; defaults to surface="flow", theme_inherit=true.

agent_form_factor.description: op=list_catalog only — narrow the catalog by mount form-factor.

catalog_profile_id.description: op=hire only — Feed A hire key (OPVS profile id from op=list_roster). A free reuse of an owned hire.

component_id.description: op=hire only — Feed B hire key: the marketplace tile id from op=list_catalog (buys a new agent).

confirm_token.description: Token from a prior dry_run call. Single-use, 7d TTL.

display_name.description: op=hire (Feed A) only — display name for the minted flow.

dry_run.description: Preview the change without mutating. Defaults to true when no confirm_token is set; call again with confirm_token to actually mutate.

embed_origins.description: op=hire only — foreign BYOS origins (scheme://host) to allowlist on the OPVS binding.

flow_id.description: Agent flow UUID. Required for op=update | publish | preview_url | get_embed_snippet. On op=hire, re-send the echoed flow_id to poll a provisioning result.

name.description: Display name. op=create requires it; op=update may set it.

profile_id.description: op=hire only — optional Feed-B OPVS profile_id cross-check.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

project_id.description: op=hire only — sp_project_id (proj_…); workspace default resolved server-side when omitted.

template_id.description: op=create only — optional template this flow was cloned from.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: agent_flow
